entities.name: amending
entities.details: City of Coral Gables City Commission approved amending the St. Philip’s School site plan under Ordinance No. 3576 to replace an existing building with a new pre-K building at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida; all other conditions of approval contained in Ordinance No. 3576 shall remain in effect.

entities.name: replace
entities.details: Replacing an existing building with a new pre-K building at 1109 Andalusia Avenue, Coral Gables, Florida, as part of the amended site plan approved by the City Commission.

entities.name: remain in effect
entities.details: All other conditions of approval contained in Ordinance No. 3576 shall remain in effect following the amendment.

entities.name: testifying
entities.details: Public speakers, including Laura Russo, Mary Beth Conroy, Cecelia Slesnick, J. C. Toyos, and Waldo Toyos, provided testimony during the City Commission meeting regarding the ordinance.

entities.name: sworn in
entities.details: City officials, including Mayor Vince Lago, Vice Mayor Rhonda Anderson, and Commissioners, were sworn in during the City Commission meeting.

entities.name: stand and raise your right hand
entities.details: City officials and speakers stood and raised their right hands during the oath-taking and ceremonial proceedings at the City Commission meeting.
